## Background

I completed a PhD in Educational Psychology at Simon Fraser University (SFU) and was a research visitor at the University of California, Berkeley. I have experience in research, instructional design, and academic data analysis.

## Why data science

I joined the MDS program to strengthen my skills in programming, statistics, machine learning, and reproducible data analysis.

## Outside of data science

Outside of data science, I enjoy traveling, exploring new places, staying active, and spending time with family and friends.
